An '''unidentified species''' had once inhabited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhand]] in the ancient past. After the original inhabitants of Rhand mysteriously disappeared, the structures that they had constructed fell into ruin. Millennia later the [[Knell of Muspilli]], [[Kanzer Exiles]], and [[Warriors of Shadow]] merged their belief systems in the [[Nihil Retreat]] with the greatest of their sorcerers taking up residence in the [[Central ruin of Rhand|central ruins]] on Rhand. These sorcerers would come to be known as the [[Sorcerers of Rhand]].
